# hevo_destinations (Data Source)

Lists the team's Destinations, ordered by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hevo_destinations" "all" {}

output "destination_names" {
  value = data.hevo_destinations.all.destinations[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes List) The Destinations. Read one with the `hevo_destination` data source for its config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `connector_id` (String) The destination connector, for example `snowflake`.
- `created_at` (String) When the Destination was created, in RFC 3339.
- `created_by` (String) Who created the Destination.
- `id` (String) The Destination's id.
- `name` (String) The Destination's display name.
- `status` (String) The Destination's status, for example `CREATED`.
- `type` (String) The destination type, for example `SNOWFLAKE`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the Destination was last changed, in RFC 3339.
- `updated_by` (String) Who last changed the Destination.
